slides.headlineRest: Breach Exposes All User Credentials, Forces Shutdown
slides.body: Blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis has disclosed that a recent cyber attack exposed names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens for all its users. The company's ongoing investigation confirmed the extensive data compromise across its systems. In response, Chainalysis has temporarily removed access to its Reactor and Data Solutions services. While there is currently no evidence that any investigative data was accessed, all users are advised to be aware of the compromised credentials.
